name: bwp-rw
description: UPDATE-capable DBHub connector (execute_sql_cade_rw, execute_sql_seo_rw, execute_sql_ranking_rw). SELECT + UPDATE only - the DB role cannot INSERT, DELETE or run DDL. Claude Code only: prompts for your personal token. Install alongside bwp-core when you need to fix row state.

dbhub_rw_token.title: Your personal DBHub update token
dbhub_rw_token.description: Issued per person (one entry in the deployments DBHUB_RW_AUTH_TOKEN secret). Grants SELECT + UPDATE on prod via execute_sql_*_rw. Never share it or commit it.
